name: General Dental Consultation
description: Comprehensive oral examination to assess dental health, identify problems, and recommend appropriate treatment plans.

name: Dental Checkups & Oral Exams
description: Routine examinations that help detect cavities, gum disease, oral infections, and other dental issues at an early stage.

name: Professional Teeth Cleaning
description: Removal of plaque, tartar, and stains from teeth to maintain oral hygiene and prevent dental diseases.

name: Dental Fillings
description: Restoration of teeth damaged by cavities using durable filling materials to restore function and appearance.

name: Tooth Extraction
description: Safe removal of severely damaged, infected, or problematic teeth when preservation is not possible.

name: Wisdom Tooth Removal
description: Surgical extraction of impacted or problematic wisdom teeth to relieve pain and prevent complications.

name: Root Canal Treatment
description: Treatment that removes infected pulp from inside a tooth, relieving pain and saving the natural tooth.

name: Dental Crowns
description: Custom-made caps placed over damaged or weakened teeth to restore their strength, function, and appearance.

name: Dental Bridges
description: Fixed dental restorations used to replace one or more missing teeth by anchoring artificial teeth to adjacent teeth.

name: Dental Implants
description: Permanent tooth replacement solution involving titanium implants that support artificial teeth.

name: Dentures
description: Removable prosthetic devices designed to replace missing teeth and restore chewing and speaking abilities.

name: Teeth Whitening
description: Cosmetic treatment that brightens teeth by removing stains and discoloration for a whiter smile.

name: Dental Veneers
description: Thin custom-made shells placed on the front of teeth to improve appearance, shape, and color.

name: Orthodontic Consultation
description: Assessment of teeth alignment and bite issues to determine the need for braces or aligners.

name: Braces Treatment
description: Orthodontic treatment that gradually straightens teeth and corrects bite problems.

name: Clear Aligners
description: Transparent removable trays used to straighten teeth discreetly without traditional braces.

name: Pediatric Dentistry
description: Specialized dental care for children, focusing on preventive treatments and oral health education.

name: Fluoride Treatment
description: Preventive treatment that strengthens tooth enamel and reduces the risk of cavities.

name: Dental Sealants
description: Protective coatings applied to chewing surfaces of teeth to prevent decay, especially in children.

name: Gum Disease Treatment
description: Diagnosis and treatment of gingivitis and periodontitis to restore gum health and prevent tooth loss.

name: Scaling and Root Planing
description: Deep cleaning procedure that removes plaque and tartar below the gum line to treat gum disease.

name: Emergency Dental Care
description: Immediate treatment for dental emergencies such as severe toothaches, broken teeth, infections, and injuries.

name: Oral Cancer Screening
description: Examination of the mouth, tongue, and surrounding tissues to detect signs of oral cancer early.

name: Dental X-Rays
description: Diagnostic imaging used to identify hidden dental problems such as cavities, bone loss, and impacted teeth.

name: Mouthguards & Night Guards
description: Custom-made appliances that protect teeth during sports activities or prevent damage from teeth grinding.

name: Smile Makeover
description: Combination of cosmetic dental procedures designed to enhance the overall appearance of a patient's smile.

name: Full Mouth Rehabilitation
description: Comprehensive treatment plan that restores oral health, function, and aesthetics for patients with extensive dental problems.
